title: SOC2 daily scratchpad - evidence + vendor reviews
body:
Daily scratchpad - security & compliance (SOC2)

Quick context:
- Working through evidence collection for common controls (access reviews, change management, logging).
- Doing light vendor reviews for high-impact vendors (SSO, logging, backups).
- This is my running todo & notes doc - noisy, half-formed, for handoffs.

2026-02-25 updates:
- Morning: synced with Priya on IDP evidence (Okta). She confirmed we can pull 'last 90 days' admin activity report. Need screenshots from Admin Console + export. TODO: ask Priya for export by EOD. (JIRA-SEC-78)
- Follow-up: infra to provide S3 bucket access logs for backups (JIRA-OPS-412). Note: logs are delivered into analytics account; need cross-account read role. TODO: create a temporary role and request access, escalate if no response by 2/27.
- Vendor review: AcmeBackup (backup provider) - still waiting on encryption-at-rest proof. Vendor sent standard certificate but not the KMS integration diagram. Action: request KMS flow and key rotation policy. Tag: vendor-critical.

Checklist (short-term):
- [ ] Okta admin activity screenshots + exported CSV (PRI: Priya)
- [ ] IAM user access review slides (generate summary table: users with >90d no login)
- [ ] S3 backup access logs export + sample log file (PRI: Infra)
- [ ] AcmeBackup KMS diagram + rotation schedule (PRI: Vendor mgr)
- [ ] Collect change management approvals for Feb 2026 infra changes (search: merge requests with label "infra-change")
- [ ] Evidence zip: include Confluence control mapping PDF, screenshots, logs (deadline: 2026-03-05 for readiness review)

Notes & open questions:
- Do we have a standardized filename convention for evidence bundles? (ask Priya) Suggest: RED_SOC2_evidence_<control>_<YYYYMMDD>.zip
- For vendor attestations: prefer SSAE/AICPA attestation + supporting config screenshots. Some vendors only provide SOC2-Type II PDF. Keep both.
- Need to confirm retention policy for access logs (SRE/infra): currently stated as 180 days in infra doc, but compliance requires 365 for control X. Open ticket to reconcile.

Short log (timeline):
- 2026-02-24 16:40 - exported list of approved SSH keys from bastion, pruning list in progress.
- 2026-02-24 11:10 - met with Noah about automated evidence collection (can we run scripts to snapshot IAM policies?). He suggested a small lambda to dump policies daily; need SRE review. Action: create design note.
- 2026-02-23 09:30 - drafted vendor questionnaire template (Vendor QA v0.2).

Handoffs / next steps if I'm OOO:
- Priya: own Okta exports and screenshots.
- Noah: run the IAM snapshot lambda POC and coordinate with SRE.
- Infra oncall: provide sample S3 access logs and confirm retention.

Helpful links & refs:
- Confluence control matrix: confluence.redwood.ai/display/SOC2/Control-Matrix
- Vendor questionnaire draft: confluence.redwood.ai/display/SOC2/Vendor-Questionnaire

Misc TODOs (low priority):
- Consolidate all evidence naming conventions and add to runbook.
- Build short script to validate screenshot presence and basic metadata (resolution, timestamp) before zipping.
- Run brief rehearsal: package evidence for 2 random controls and time the process - target < 60m.

Unresolved blockers:
- KMS docs from AcmeBackup. Email sent 2026-02-20, follow-up scheduled 2026-02-27.
- Cross-account role for logs access - infra needs to confirm trust relationship.

End of scratchpad.
